# Product Update — July 4, 2026

## What Shipped

Three updates landed on main:

**Stable handles for unnamed members.** When someone joins the Commons without setting a username, they now get an auto-generated stable handle instead of a shifting identifier. A nudge in the interface encourages them to set their own username when they're ready.

**Quora link fix.** The Quora profile link now opens through the standard ShareLink popup instead of breaking the flow.

**Skill taxonomy cleanup.** Removed near-duplicate marketing skill pairs via change ops 37, 38, and 39. The Agribusiness marketing skill is now deactivated. This keeps the skill list lean and reduces confusion when browsing or editing.

## Why It Matters

Unnamed members can now participate in the Commons without a jarring or unstable identity. Profile links work as expected. A thinner taxonomy means clearer choices when you're setting up skills or exploring what's available.
